items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: The name 'Ladnier' appears only in a note by the interviewer; the interviewee does not mention Ladnier or describe any relationship with them.

ctx.x: Well, let's get back to Europe, when you came back. Who was with you when you went back to Europe in 1927?

I had Tommy Langley, again went back with me. But, Doc Cheatham and Jerry Blake and Freddie Johnson. They were the only new men that I had. The rest of them were the old fellows that had been there before.
